crossRefs.note: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.
Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t…
For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you will not exalt them.
What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled…
Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this…
I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his…

translations.web: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
translations.bsb: But come back and try again, all of you. For I will not find a wise man among you.
translations.kjv: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise
translations.asv: But as for you all, come on now again; And I shall not find a wise man among you.
